_comment: Input of pfr_runner.py. RateNet (c321788e) envelope: T <= 1601 K (dense 495-1182 K), p 1-4 bar, rho 0.16-19 kg/m3, steam ratio 0.40-0.60
_case: TBLOCK validation duct for RateNet c321788e: adiabatic (TBLOCK has no isothermal walls with the lump gas), T_in 1150 K, 2 bar, 100 m/s (M 0.2), 3 m = ~30 ms. Best of the adiabatic sweep (README)
_models: cantera = detailed mechanism; any other name = a RateNet export folder under models/
_wall_htc_Wm2K: gas-wall heat transfer coefficient, constant; 0 = adiabatic duct
_wall_temperature_profile: wall T(x), Main_1 knot format: position relative 0..1, 'step' holds the knot value to the next knot, 'linear' ramps to it; unused when wall_htc_Wm2K is 0
